newsitem.title: UK: ASDA seen rising as results impress.
newsitem.headline: ASDA seen rising as results impress.

text.p: Shares in ASDA Group Plc were expected to open higher after the British supermarket group posted annual results that topped analysts' best forecasts.
The shares were up 2p to 124 in pre-market trading at 715 GMT.
ASDA said its pre-tax profits rose to 405.2 million stg in the fiscal year ended May 3 from 311.5 million stg a year ago.
"The numbers are good, showing a strong performance from a number of divisions, particularly clothing," said one analyst. "I'd expect to see some upgrades today."
